name: Lynn Loud Jr
source:
The Fifth born member of the Loud family is my most competitive sister Lynn! I don't think I can stress it enough, just *HOW* Competitive Lynn is.

Yeah sure, I could describe her as a typical jock... She loves sports, any and all sports…but it's more than that, she just loves to compete. With anyone, over anything... and she can be one heck of a sore loser when she doesn't win.

She's also full of superstitions and does all kinds of weird rituals before a big game or tournament. She'll drag family into them if it's a game she's watching as well.

Despite all this, she does have a hidden sweet side, and she's the closest to me in age. She's the one who taught me how to ride a bike and I'm probably not a complete couch potato because she makes me play so many games with her. Out of all my sisters, Lynn is probably the closest thing I have to a ‘brother'. She's a tomboy through and through, but every once in awhile, her feminine side asserts itself and reminds me she's a girl.

For some reason, while my other sisters call me [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]Lincoln[/url], Linc, or Lincy affectionately… Lynn likes to call me "[i]Stinkin[/i]". She's not even mean about it, I think she's being affectionate when she says it too.

[In game description]
